name: Google Workspace: pull Alert Center alerts
description: Every 5 minutes, reads new Google Workspace Alert Center alerts (government-backed attack warnings, leaked passwords, suspicious logins, Gmail phishing, device compromise, sensitive admin actions, rule alerts) and creates one pending alert per Alert Center alert.

params.label: Admin to impersonate
params.help: Email of the Workspace admin the service account acts as (domain-wide delegation). Needs the Alert Center privilege (View access is enough).

secrets.name: GWS_SA_KEY
secrets.description: Full JSON key of the Google Cloud service account used to read Alert Center alerts (domain-wide delegation for the apps.alerts scope).

setup:
### Google Cloud side
1. In a Google Cloud project: APIs & Services > Library > enable **Google Workspace Alert Center API**.
2. IAM & Admin > Service accounts > **Create service account** (no project roles needed). Open it > Keys > Add key > **JSON**; keep the file.
3. On the service account's Details page copy the **Unique ID / OAuth 2 Client ID** (numeric).

### Admin console side (super admin)
1. Security > Access and data control > API controls > **Manage Domain Wide Delegation** > Add new: paste the client ID, OAuth scopes `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/apps.alerts`, Authorize. It can take up to 24 h to apply.
2. Pick the admin to impersonate (`ADMIN_EMAIL`). Super Admin and Services Admin already have full Alert Center access; for least privilege use a custom role with Account > Admin roles > Privileges > **Alert Center: View access** only (reporting rule alerts also need the Reports privilege, DLP alerts a DLP privilege).

### Here
1. Settings > Secrets: add `GWS_SA_KEY` with the whole JSON key file as the value, allowed hosts `oauth2.googleapis.com` (token exchange) **and** `alertcenter.googleapis.com` (API call): the access token is bound to the hosts of the key's secret.
2. Install with `ADMIN_EMAIL`.

Token: a JWT signed with the key (`sub` = `ADMIN_EMAIL`, scope `apps.alerts`) is exchanged at `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token`; the access token is cached per worker until shortly before it expires and never stored.

### What it calls
`GET https://alertcenter.googleapis.com/v1beta1/alerts?filter=createTime >= "<previous run>"&orderBy=createTime desc&pageSize=100` (filter URL-encoded; `customerId` is inferred from the impersonated admin). Each alert becomes an alert with source `google-workspace`, external id = `alertId`, title = `type` plus the affected user (`data.email`) when the alert has one, payload = the whole Alert Center alert (including `data` and `metadata`).

Severity: by alert type first (Potential ransomware detected = critical; Government attack warning, Leaked password, Device compromised, Suspicious programmatic login, User suspended (suspicious activity), admin-privilege / SSO / super admin password changes, Customer takeout initiated, Malware reclassification, Phishing in inboxes due to bad whitelist = high; Suspicious login, Suspicious login (less secure app), Suspicious device activity, user-reported / reclassified phishing = medium; spam suspensions, user and settings changes = low; outages, MSA, APNS and configuration notices = info); other types (Activity Rule, Reporting Rule, Data Loss Prevention, new types) use `metadata.severity` HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW, else medium.

### Limits
ponytail: one page per run (`pageSize=100`, newest first); `nextPageToken` is not followed, so more than 100 new alerts in 5 minutes keeps only the newest 100. The window is on `createTime`, and runs overlap safely (the same `alertId` never creates a second alert). Alert Center API quotas apply per project (see the Cloud console quotas page). A non-200 answer (key not authorised for the scope, admin without Alert Center access, 429) creates nothing and fails the run with the HTTP status; the next run re-reads the window from the last successful run (at most 24 h back).

Docs: [alerts.list](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/alertcenter/reference/rest/v1beta1/alerts/list), [Alert resource](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/alertcenter/reference/rest/v1beta1/alerts), [Query filters](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/alertcenter/guides/query-filters), [Alert types](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/alertcenter/reference/alert-types), [Domain-wide delegation](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/directory/v1/guides/delegation), [Grant access to the alert center](https://support.google.com/a/answer/9176596).
